Close — 'bombarded' means to attack with many things simultaneously, which fits the sense of overwhelming requests, but it emphasizes the force or intensity rather than the figurative siege context.
Close — 'assailed' means to attack or criticize severely, which fits the context of overwhelming requests, but it emphasizes aggressive attack rather than the surrounding or overwhelming quality.
